title: Pull-Down Assay to Assess ATG2A Binding to WIPI4 and LC3B
author: Elisabeth Holzer
materials: Analyze collected fractions by Western blot. Detect ATG2A ( anti-ATG2A Proteintech Catalog #23226-1-AP (RRID: AB_2879235) ) and HIS-tagged WIPI4 ( anti-HIS Qiagen Catalog #34660 (RRID: AB_2619735) ) using specific antibodies.

steps.title: Incubate ATG2A beads with proteins
steps.instruction: Incubate beads coated with 3×FLAG-tagged ATG2A (5 µL slurry per condition) with 5 µM purified 6×HIS-tagged WIPI4, LC3B, or GFP (negative control) in SEC300 buffer.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature with gentle rotation.

steps.title: Wash and prepare beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads once with 100 µL SEC300 buffer, then add 40 µL SEC300 buffer to the beads.

steps.title: Fractionate the sample
steps.instruction: Split the sample into two equal parts: a low-salt fraction and a high-salt fraction.

substeps.instruction: Store the low-salt fraction on ice for analysis.

steps.title: Wash high-salt fraction
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes on the high-salt fraction using 100 µL of buffer for each wash.

steps.title: Resuspend and prepare for loading
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads from both the low-salt and high-salt fractions in 20 µL SEC300 and mix with SDS loading buffer.
